articles.body:
Welcome to the Official Grand Theft Auto VI Strategy Guide and Map. Here you'll find step-by-step walkthroughs for every mission, a massive interactive map with thousands of locations to explore and check off your list, and a 100% guide for your collections and collectibles. GTA 6 is the story of Jason and Lucia, and each decision you make may affect not only the living world of Leonida around you, but your relationship, and we will explain how your choices lead to different outcomes. IGN collaborated with Rockstar Games on this Official GTA 6 Guide to answer any question you might have about Grand Theft Auto VI, whether you are a veteran of the GTA series or a newcomer: This is the guide for you. Welcome!

The sections below are just the start of the Grand Theft Auto VI Official Strategy Guide, navigate to the guide menu at the top left of the screen to dig into the full guide, or use the search bar.

Our interactive GTA 6 map has markers for every collectible and activity, including cool and unique Vehicles, Stunts , Illegal Operations , businesses and much, much more. Filter and search to find what you need, and check it off with our built-in checklists to track your completion (create an account to be sure to save your progress).

The Official Grand Theft Auto VI Strategy Guide features a step-by-step Walkthrough with a complete list of Missions and where to start them, and detailed accounts of how your choices affect the game in case you don't want to just shoot from the hip.

GTA 6 tracks all sorts of things that lead to the "A Long Road" Achievement/Trophy that in turn is required to get a Platinum Trophy/100% Achievements. There is A LOT to do.

GTA 6 is not all chaos and crime, it's also a love story. A chaotic one with lots of crime. This section outlines the many ways your Jason and Lucia 's relationship can wax and wane, and what affect that may have on gameplay. But that's not all -- your behavior also affects your Criminal Profile, so check out our guide to that, too.

There are SO MANY THINGS to collect in GTA 6. We have a complete list in the Official Strategy Guide including checklists you can check off for each, and it's all tied to the Interactive Map as well -- check one off in the guide, and it will check it off on the map. Magic!

articles.body:
The vault at Sinfrontera National Bank isn’t something that can be cracked easily. At Nicole’s suggestion, Jason and Lucia are sent to steal a safe the crew can use for practice before they hit the real deal. In this official GTA 6 walkthrough , you’ll learn how to steal the safe along with notes on a few choices and their outcomes in the Grand Theft Auto VI Chapter 3 main mission, Safe Word.

Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:

Visit the lockup in Stockyard to begin the mission. Nicole explains the safe you’re stealing is the personal version of the vault in the bank, making it an ideal practice device before the big day. Your target is on the first-floor office of a porn website owner’s house. Outside you’ll find a large pickup truck, a Bravado Bison 3800, with a large winch on the back. Get in with your partner. A few seconds later, Karim texts the mansion address. The porn mogul’s mansion is south in Peacock Bay’s Peacock Estates.

The drive down south is long, but busy. Karim and Nicole get in contact with extra information as Jason and Lucia chat. Karim makes a point to tell Jason and Lucia that this mission is meant to be quiet – excluding the whole "ripping a safe out of a wall" part. As you approach the guard station at the entrance of Peacock Estates, Jason automatically says they’re there to see about a pool and get let in immediately. Drive down and park on the right side of the street.

If you take a violent approach upon arriving at the home, you won’t get to participate in a Tap to Reveal You’ll also attract the attention of the estate security.

Lucia stays behind, leaving you as Jason to find a way in. The front gate is open just a bit, making for the perfect entrance. The two security guards at the front of the mission get together near the garage and look at a video shortly after you get on the property. So long as you stay crouched and keep your distance, they shouldn’t notice you. The front door is locked so you’ll need to go around the east side of the house. If you get caught Tap to Reveal

The first door here isn’t open, so you’ll need to keep walking around the house. Once you’re by the pool, sneaking around isn’t necessary. Go past the pool and around the back for another door, but no luck. The west side of the house it is. On the way, though, Jason is intercepted by Gil’s assistant, who assumes she’s the pool boy they’ve been waiting for. A cutscene begins as Jason is put to work.

Move to your first mark, the skimmer by the pool. Wait until the director calls for Jason to pick up the skimmer with Triangle/Y and move the pole back and forth in the pool as the scene plays out. Lucia makes her own commentary as she listens in from afar.

Next, the director tells Jason to look at Samantha, then to really notice her. You’ll be able to do anything other than skim the pool as soon as the new objective marker appears over Samantha. Hold the L2 / LT to focus on her, then when prompted, press and hold Triangle / Y until the director is satisfied. A little bit more pool skimming later and Jason gets his closeup. Move over and pick up the lotion.

As directed, spread the lotion on Sasha. You can move up and down Sasha’s back and rub it in with the left and right thumbsticks. Once that part is done, reapply lotion in your hands with R2 / RT then begin the whole lotion process all over again as they retake the shot.

Next is a "fight" with Rodney. Give him a few punches before the director calls for you to let him get some hits in. When it’s your turn to knock him out, hit him relentlessly to knock him out. If you take too long or if Rodney dodges too much, the director calls for Rodney to fake getting hit to move on the scene.

Things move along as the director calls for the women to disrobe and prepare for the sex scenes with Rodney and the pool boy. Suddenly, they all turn to you and ask…are you good? You get two choices:

Cross / A – Participate (If you choose this Tap to Reveal )

Square / X – Don’t Participate (If you choose this Tap to Reveal )

Jason is free to enter the mansion. Walk around the side of the house and go through the door marked by the "actor's showers" sign. You can’t explore much of the mansion, but if you go left immediately, you can grab a Zombix from the bathroom counter. Continue through the hallway and enter the office doors on the right. It’s a bright, spacious room. You can interact with the camera on the tripod, with the statues on the wall behind the desk, and with the desk drawer. The first two are optional, so hold off on opening the desk drawer if you want to look around first.

The drawer holds the remote Jason was told to look for. After hitting a few buttons, the TV turns on, blasting sound, but the safe is also revealed. Meet Lucia at the window to grab the winch. Attach it to the safe with Triangle / Y .

Jason runs to the truck and you swap to Lucia. Hold R2 / RT until the safe finally releases from the wall. Driving with the safe behind you is both a blessing and curse. It’s an incredible tool for destruction, but if you focus too much on swinging it or get it caught on something, it can slow down your escape.

You can go whatever direction you want and the GPS will adjust like normal, but for this particular escape, keeping to the GPS directions is particularly helpful – and devious. You’ll pass through areas that have wider roads and you'll only have to take a few turns, but you’ll also come across unique obstacles, like a number of people riding bikes together. If you accidentally crash severely into anything while driving there’s a good chance the truck's engine will be okay (this very particular truck is sturdy), but you can choose to reset to the last checkpoint if you’d rather have a cleaner escape.

If the cops are on you when you get close to the warehouse, Karim texts and tells you to lose them before going to the drop off spot. The easiest way to do this here is to destroy the cop vehicles with the safe and to drive offroad through farmland.

Upon approaching the warehouse where Felipe is waiting, the cop presence dissipates, allowing you to safely deliver the truck and its cargo. A cutscene closes out the delivery.

At the lockup, Nicole is on the phone with Gil. When she’s finally gotten him off her back, she offers to let you practice cracking the safe now or later. If you choose now, you’ll go straight into learning how to crack the safe. If you tell her later, you can come back before the heist to learn how the system works.

Cracking the safe is an activity for only Lucia and Nicole, so Jason will leave if you have him. The first time you practice cracking the safe, Nicole sets up a failsafe so if you fail, you’re not actually locked out. Getting into the safe requires the following three steps:

You have two meters to match for the left and right triggers. While you can begin with both at once, I find it easier (and faster) to start with the right then to the left. First, match the R2 / RT side. It sometimes requires building pressure, but more often than not, in practice you can pull tight and hold it at a high pressure to get it where it needs to be for the remaining step of this mini game.

L2 / LT moves as progress is made and requires a slower increase in pressure, while you’ll need to press and hold R2 / RT steady at a higher pressure. If you press L2 / LT too lightly, you won’t make progress (you’re timed). If you press too hard and see the red light, you’ll overheat the drill and need to spend time letting it cool down.

You have a limited amount of time to find and hook the failsafe trigger. The trigger sometimes hides behind objects within the safe, so use the red and white cable as a clue for finding it. The failsafe trigger shines faintly in the dark, so look out for that too.

All objects in this section have sensors that make the failsafe go off, so you must move slowly, carefully, and not hit anything while going for the failsafe trigger. You’ll know you’re getting too close when you see the blue lights around the edge of the screen indicating proximity.

If you find that you’ve moved the hook into a corner and need to double-back, press Triangle / Y to reset . It’s in your best interest to reset if you accidentally navigate to the failsafe's entry point (shown below), which is the wrong end of the cable!

If you’re wondering why you have to hook the failsafe trigger, it’s so that Lucia can hold it in place after Nicole breaks the glass in the door. Breaking the glass normally pulls the trigger and shuts down the safe, but because Lucia is holding onto it when the glass breaks, the safe is still crackable.

The final part is also tough. Nicole is going to break the glass and needs you to hold the failsafe in place. Hold both triggers then get ready to mash Cross / A as long as Nicole needs you to. If you drop it, the safe can’t be cracked. Nicole will call out the step she’s at so you can know how much time you have left to hold the failsafe. The last part isn’t easy! If you fail any of the three sections, Nicole offers to reset the safe and allow you to retry the section again.

If this mini game isn’t your cup of tea, there’s a setting you can use to make this whole process more straightforward. To do so, pause and go to Settings > Gameplay , then scroll all the way down to Simplified Mini Games . Toggle that on and it’ll apply to the safe cracking.

Drilling into the door : Hold RT at any pressure

Finding the failsafe trigger : The only way to fail this part is by running out of time. It’s okay if you bump the sides!

Keep the failsafe in place : Press X to secure the line while Nicole cracks the code.

If you like the other minigames, you can toggle the Simplified Mini Games option (and others in the gameplay menu) anytime!

Successfully opening the safe the first time earns you a unique weapon variant, Gil's Kalinga .50, and $1,500.

You can return to Raul's Planning Room anytime as Lucia to practice cracking the safe. When you do, you may be challenged to do each step faster and the failsafe trigger’s location moves.

Looking for something to do next? If you have any cartel heist preparation missions or other main missions, they’ll help things move along with the story. If you’re looking to see what else Leonida has to offer, I recommend taking a minute to drive around and see what calls to you – literally. Otherwise, here are some other helpful guides:

This walkthrough features some first-person elements. Those come from IGN's GTA 6 Lead Editor, Miranda Sanchez. You can learn more about Miranda and her experience on the About the GTA 6 Guide Editors page .

articles.body:
The official Grand Theft Auto VI Chapter 4 walkthrough includes strategies for main missions, suggestions for side activities, directions for optional missions, and plenty more. In GTA 6’s Chapter 4 – Vice City, Baby, Lucia and Jason move to a new safehouse and work hard to try and find out what’s on the mysterious hard drive so they can put it all behind them and start their new life with Tomás.

Click on a link below to jump to that specific section of this guide:

GTA 6 Chapter 4 Main Mission Walkthroughs

There are 27 main missions in GTA 6’s Chapter 4. Below are complete guides for each, including initial mission objective descriptions and rewards. Please be careful when scrolling as some mission titles, thumbnails, and descriptions contain spoilers or allude to spoilers.

You’re already used to being in Vice City after moving there at the start of Chapter 3 and not much has changed. The main difference is that Jason and Lucia’s home base is now at the Y Hotel in Vice Beach.

Almost immediately after moving into the Y Hotel, you gain access to the hotel’s car services. These are incredibly helpful for getting to places quickly. You can use the phone or tablet in the hotel room to call your vehicle or call a car service. If you call your vehicle, it automatically puts you inside your chosen vehicle – no need to manually go down to the lobby and find it.

You can use the phone or tablet in the hotel room to call your vehicle or call a car service. If you call your vehicle, it automatically puts you inside your chosen vehicle – no need to manually go down to the lobby and find it.

If you call a car service, it automatically puts you inside a Y Hotel car with your own private driver. Press Square / X to Set Destination, which opens your map. The driver will literally take you anywhere in Leonida, provided it can be driven to (if it can’t be driven to, they’ll take you as close to it as possible). Once you’ve decided on a location, hold Cross / A to confirm and they will begin driving. If you want to get to your destination quicker, hold L2 / LT and press Circle / B to tell them to hurry, or hold Triangle / Y to skip the journey altogether and go there instantly.

Outside the Y Hotel entrance, there are rentable cars that you can take for a spin, but you do need to pay to do so.

You also get two cars for free – one for Jason and one for Lucia – in the Company Cars main mission, which is one of the beginning missions in Chapter 4.

You can call room service via the tablet in Lucia and Jason’s hotel room. It has some expensive options, such as $142 wagyu gold leaf burgers and champagne. These don’t do anything that regular food items don’t do, but it’s fun if you want to feel luxurious for a moment.

There’s a WAiNK Location to scan directly outside the Y Hotel, to the right of the main entrance: the Princess Robot Bubblegum Statue.

There’s a boat available to you if you have the Ultimate Edition : the Shitzu Squalo. It’s on the river just to the left of the Y Hotel. Not only is there scuba gear on it, but there’s a weapon chest containing a rocket launcher, a grenade launcher, and a few frag grenades.

The beach is nearby. It is a very chill area, primed for relaxation – or chaos, if you prefer. There is a cluster of Seashark jet skis in the water directly east of the Y Hotel and you can rent one for free.

Check the lifeguard shacks lined along the beach. Sometimes, you may find free Adrenaline or Zombix . A couple of them have Collectible Cards inside.

If you’re lucky, you may hear a dog barking on the beach directly east of the Y Hotel. Use Focus to find it if you need to; it’s stolen someone’s wallet. When you approach the dog, it runs off, then stops and looks back at you, beckoning you to follow. Do so, and it leads you to some valuables: the wallet it stole, which contains cash and a B&G Ark Royal Ashore Chrono luxury watch .

After the Company Cars main mission, the Thompson Court Garage is unlocked for you to store two vehicles in. It’s located in the Ocean Beach area of Vice Beach.

After the Photo/Shoot main mission, a Nagasaki KD’S SFB 1000 sportsbike becomes available to you via the Dre’Quan’s Gift map objective. Head over and pick it up, then take it to the Pay ‘n’ Spray next door to register it, if you’d like. It costs $3,150 to do so.

Making money in Chapter 4 does not differ much from Chapter 3: you can still do jobs for Yasmani , steal cars for Moses and Randy , take on Illegal Operations, and more. Your fences – Yasmani, Tyrone, and Dunk – remain the same, too.

Vice Beach is a pretty wealthy section of Vice City, so there are some high value targets to hit, though, including Bank Jobs and Big Bank Jobs:

Don’t forget about your BuckMe Family Savings goals! Without spoiling anything, if you have spent time maintaining Jason and Lucia’s Criminal Profiles at Professional and have been keeping their relationship level at the maximum, you might want to ensure you’ve hit the top $2 million goal pretty soon.

Most Optional Missions that can be completed in Chapter 3 can also be completed in Chapter 4, though there are some new ones. To see the list of Optional Missions and how to start them, visit our complete guide .

articles.summary: This official GTA 6 guide covers an early, free Rocket Launcher location you can freely run to in Chapter 1 -- it's not even locked behind a puzzle, you
articles.body:
This official GTA 6 guide covers an early, free Rocket Launcher location you can freely run to in Chapter 1 -- it's not even locked behind a puzzle, you just need to know how to get there. Here's how!

Oh, and there's a Unique Weapon Variant in this bunker location as well, and a bunch of Frag Grenades, too.

Sorry, there's no cheat code in GTA 6 that will get you a Rocket Launcher early in the game. But what's GTA without a Rocket Launcher rampage? Here's how to get one fair and square!

Rocket Launcher Location and Conspiracist Bunker

We are going to show you how to get to a cool little Easter egg-y area but since your map may not be uncovered, drop a marker to the north of the starting area in the Keys, and just west of Vice City . Here's the exact, unfogged location.

For un-fogged mappers, set your coordinates like this:

Here's that total path up to the bunker, starting from Hamlet, for you fogged players.

This will get you near the Griffin Firing Range. Kitty-cornered to that is an impound lot, just to the south-west.

The gate's unlocked! The locals here aren't armed and they can't see you on the path you are about to follow, but they will call the police if they do see you.

Look for the RV covered and smothered in antennae and satellite dishes.

Enter it from the north. Inside you will see a bunker hatch.

As you open it you will hear an explosion. The gory scene below and a lone smart phone will tell the backstory of this bunker, but we'll let you discover that for yourselves. The Hauners H-AT Rocket Launcher is leaned up against one of the safes as you enter the main room downstairs.

Yep, it's a Rocket Launcher! And it has 4 shots! But wait... there's more!

You want to rampage more, right? Well, you won't be able to buy ammo for the rocket launcher so after 4 shots, you are out. Save before you fire it.

You can max your Frag Grenade loadout here as well, for more explosions! And there's a cool Collectible / Unique Weapon Variant here, the Conspiracist Type 9 SMG. There's also a ton of Adrenaline and Zombix that you can collect for healing on the go.

Note that you cannot buy a Rocket Launcher even if you store it early in the game, but you can store it in your trunk, and you will permanently own the SMG. Using your new SMG, Rocket Launcher and Grenades is an easy way to get to a 5-star wanted level.

If you want to find more Unique Weapon Variants like the Conspiracist, check out our interactive map!

For more guide pages about criminal actions you can undertake in Grand Theft Auto VI, check out IGN's official guide pages!

articles.title: VCIA Takedown Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: After the Real Dimez' launch party at Club VYB in Grand Theft Auto VI's Headliners mission, Nate finally calls Lucia: Kordell Grant is ready to hit
articles.body:
After the Real Dimez' launch party at Club VYB in Grand Theft Auto VI 's Headliners mission , Nate finally calls Lucia: Kordell Grant is ready to hit the airport. This official GTA 6 IGN guide walks you through the VCIA Takedown main mission.

Once Nate contacts Lucia, she calls Raul to let him know it's time for the heist. He asks her and Jason to meet at his planning room to get this thing started. When you're ready to start the mission, buzz the intercom and head inside. Raul gives Lucia an earpiece so they can communicate, then she heads back out to meet Kordell's crew. Everyone else gets one, too, to listen in. At the airport, Kordell goes over the plan with everyone — including Raina, who's been let back into the crew unexpectedly. Lucia and Nate head inside the airport and go through security, posing as normal civilians taking a flight, before they go to a bathroom to change into VCIA employee uniforms. Nate hands Lucia a syringe filled with a sedative…you don't want to know where he was storing it.

Follow Nate through the airport as the pair talks over their part of the plan – Lucia needs to find and take care of the wine expert so she can assume her identity. They reach a coffee stand and you switch to Jason. He's driving the Plane & Simple truck you stole during the Fully Catered main mission through a security checkpoint. The guard checks Andrea's ID and waves them on through.

Drive the truck to the cargo terminal, following the GPS route. It's 0.37 miles away. When you arrive, pull up to the white "KEEP CLEAR" shutters, indicated by a pink arrow. You switch back to Lucia. Her and Nate are monitoring the arrivals gate for the wine expert, named Janice. She arrives and agrees to be "escorted." Follow Nate as he takes her through the airport.

He turns to ask Janice a question and "accidentally" spills his coffee all over her. Oops. She heads to the nearby bathroom to clean up. Follow Janice into the bathroom. She's cleaning herself at the mirror and is mad Lucia has come in after her – she thinks she's impatient. You can hold L2 / LT to Defuse ( Cross / A ) or Taunt ( Square / X ) her for some extra dialogue.

Go right behind her and press R2 / RT to grab and drug her. Lucia then drags Janice into an empty bathroom stall before changing into her outfit.

Lucia and Nate head to the back to do the wine authentication.

If you successfully hacked into the TSS database as Jason during the Delivery Method main mission , Lucia has an easier time during the security check and passes through with zero problems.

If you didn't hack the TSS database during the Delivery Method main mission, Lucia has a harder time getting through the security check. It cuts to Lucia in line, where a security guard asks for her ID. Press Triangle / Y to show it.

Her ID and fingerprints do not match, but they let her through anyway for the interest of time. Phew.

While checking out the wine crates, Raul slips Lucia a tracking device while passing her a form. Follow the vault manager, passing Kordell, Raina, and Francisco as they pose as undercover security.

You get into an elevator. The vault manager asks "Janice" what "hot" wine means. You have two possible answers:

You can answer however you'd like here. There's some slight dialogue change depending on your choice, but it has no overall effect on the success of the mission. Shortly after you answer, you'll switch over to Jason.

You have five minutes to reach the network terminal. It's across the other side of the tarmac and the best way to get there is across the rooftops, taking out the snipers and security guards as you go so they're not a problem for later. Though you cannot get caught or you fail the mission , so be careful!

If you are spotted and fail the mission, the checkpoint is at the start of the area, so don't worry – you're not set back far.

The route to the network terminal is across rooftops and there are some path variations. Here's the route I took, but feel free to get there however you'd like.

Once you switch to Jason, immediately head down the stairs and across the roof to another set of stairs leading up to another roof.

There's a security guard on this roof. Take him out without being spotted, then go up the stairs to another roof.

Go over the first set of bridge stairs, then go up the ladder to the left.

There's another guard below you . Jump down and take care of him, then climb the ladder ahead of you up to a small rooftop.

Climb down the ladder on the other side. There's another, higher rooftop ahead of you, with another guard. He climbs down a ladder onto the same level Jason is, then walks ahead. Sneak up behind him and take him out. You can also sneak past him before he climbs down if you're quick enough!

At the top, another security guard is patrolling. They turn to face you; quickly head left and wrap around to another ladder you can take up before they spot you.

Walk forward and go up the ladder next to the bright light.

At the top, turn left and take the ladder here.

There's another ladder to the right. Ignore it . Instead, walk around to the right , though watch out – there's another guard here. You can take them down if you want, or wait for them to walk past and sneak by.

A gated area is on the left. Go inside it, then open the network terminal with Triangle / Y . You'll switch to Lucia after successfully interacting with the airport network terminal.

You are back with the vault manager as Lucia, and they're at the vault entrance. Nate's clearance doesn't let him in. Follow him down the hallway and he opens the vault.

The vault manager tells Lucia to inspect the wine to ensure she's happy with it. Approach the crate and press Triangle / Y to open it.

Press Triangle / Y again to inspect the wine bottle. Kordell tells her to hold for a moment via her earpiece, so you need to examine the bottle a couple more times. Then you get the signal : take out the vault manager. Press Square / X and Lucia smashes the bottle in his face, knocking him out.

If the additional security guard entered the vault with you, you need to knock him out, too. After Lucia attacks the vault manager, she automatically moves onto the security guard.

Attack him, using Square / X to knock him out. If he grabs Lucia, you need to mash Square / X to escape his grip.

Once he's knocked out, pick him up and carry him over to the cage with the vault manager. Lucia locks him inside.

Rush forward and go back the way you came, toward the vault entrance. There are two gates that you need to open so that the crew can get inside. The first switch is on the left after leaving the vault .

The second switch is at the end of the hallway on the left . You can see Nate rounding up security guards at gunpoint on the other side.

Kordell, Raina, and Francisco appear and head into the vault. When you're given control of Lucia again, follow them inside. Nate slides Lucia some bags, and she slips the tracker inside one of them.

Follow the gang outside the vault with the cash to a baggage area. They put the bags onto a conveyor belt, and Francisco radios Omar, who is waiting to transport the bags at the other end.

You're Jason again, who is at the baggage pickup with Raul and Andrea. Omar is also there, none the wiser that his new employee is actually undercover. Follow Raul to Omar, who is standing by the conveyor belt, waiting for the bags. Sneak up behind him and press R2 / RT to grab him and knock him out. Pick Omar up with Triangle / Y , then carry him over to an empty baggage cart storage container on the other side of the room. When you approach, Jason automatically stuffs him inside.

Andrea sets up a voice changer. Raul uses it to radio over to Francisco and inform him that the bags are coming through. They mark the bags with the real cash and replace them with the bags of fake cash they prepared earlier.

Unfortunately, Kordell does not trust Omar. As they're driving away in a getaway truck, Kordell instructs them to pull over – he wants to visit the baggage area, and check Omar isn't doing anything dodgy with the cash.

Jason and Andrea drive away with the real cash just in time. You switch to Lucia again as she heads to the baggage area with Nate and Francisco. Omar isn't there, of course, and what they think are the bags with the real cash are left in plain sight. Lucia and Nate get into a baggage tug with an undercover Raul, posing as a worker. Francisco stays, looking for Omar.

Drive it over to the plane, which is 0.34 miles away. The GPS routes you there.

When you arrive at the plane, you need to load the bags. Press Triangle / Y to pick one up from the baggage tug, then again to place it onto the conveyor belt attached to the plane.

Francisco radios: he can't find Omar. He tells Nate to check the bags. Continue loading as he argues with Raul, who tells him there's no time to look. Kordell appears and recognizes Raul, realizing they've been duped. He instantly accuses Lucia of being in on it and points a gun at her.

Chaos ensues in the scene that follows, and N.O.O.S.E. arrive. Kordell forces Raul onto the plane with Raina.

Jason hears the sirens and instantly grows worried about Lucia – he’s going after her. When you gain control, you're armed and on the tarmac. Take out law enforcement as you move to Lucia's position. You have an automatic 4-Star Wanted Level.

Fight your way over to the plane, using the vehicles as cover as needed. If you need a shotgun, which is very useful here, check the bodies of any officers you take out as at least one should have one.

As you get near the plane, you switch to Lucia automatically. Jason joins her and they're quickly surrounded by more enemies. Take out as many cops as possible while you defend yourself. About a minute or so later, you'll automatically switch to Jason again.

Andrea contacts Jason. They’ve got another problem to worry about now: Francisco found Omar and hijacked the van containing the real cash…and Karim. Jason and Lucia rush into a truck. Drive it over to the moving plane in front of you.

Go to the wheels, where there’s an open compartment. Match the plane’s speed for a few seconds and Lucia automatically jumps inside.

Drive to the truck ahead of you, which is being chased by three police cars. Join in on the chase and follow it onto a highway. You can ignore the police cars, or shoot out their drivers, engines, or tires if you’d rather get them off the road to make it easier.

Mid-chase, you switch over to Lucia in the plane, which has now taken off. Raina appears. It's time to permanently get her out of the way. This begins like any other fight: press Cross / A right as Raina attacks to parry, then quickly press Square / X to counterattack. Hold Cross / A to block.

Raina grabs Lucia and puts her in a lock – we’ve seen this before back at the motel. Mash Square / X to push her off.

They fumble and slide down onto the open hatch, dangerously close to falling to their deaths. Raina tries to strangle Lucia; mash Square / X again to end the fight.

You’re Jason again, in hot pursuit of the truck. They’ve managed to shake the police off their tails so it’s just you and the truck now. Francisco throws out a large metal case – dodge it! He shoots as you approach. Do your best to avoid the gunfire. Don’t worry too much about getting right up behind the truck, though. As long as you stay within reasonable distance to it and don’t let them escape, you'll be good.

As you leave the highway and get back onto regular roads, the truck crashes and overturns. Get out of your vehicle and approach the back. Francisco bursts out and he’s wielding a massive gun.

Use the barrier next to you for cover, whip out your gun, and aim at Francisco. Don’t forget to use Combat Focus ( Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click / Left Stick Click + Right Stick Click ) if you need some additional time to line up your shot.

Quick! Rush over to Francisco's body to grab Francisco’s LMG 6 unique weapon variant. Francisco's LMG 6

After stopping Francisco, Omar climbs out of the truck. You can either spare him ( Cross / A ) and let him run away, which gives Jason Professional points toward his Criminal Profile , or kill him. If you do kill him, Jason receives Violent points toward his Criminal Profile.

Return to the back of the truck and Andrea appears. They load her vehicle up with the cash.

In the air, Lucia has made it into the plane’s cabin. You need to find Raul. Move through the cabin, taking out Kordell’s goons as you go. When you reach the front of the plane, turn around and go upstairs to the second level .

At the top, Kordell suddenly tackles Lucia to the ground. Raul and the pilot grab him before he can shoot her and throw him against the exit door. Mash Square / X to punch him.

Kordell breaks free, killing the pilot and pushing Lucia to the floor again. He aims his gun at her; mash Square / X again and she pushes him down the stairs. Lucia manages to grab his gun. Mash Square / X again to stop him from taking it.

Lucia shoots the plane door and it bursts open. Kordell grabs onto her leg to stop himself from being sucked out into the sky. Press Square / X three times to kick him off. He falls, but grips onto the sides of the door.

You enter Combat Focus and you’re given a couple of seconds to Tap to Reveal . If you don’t, he lunges back into the plane, grabs Lucia, and they both fall to their deaths. Don’t worry if you do fail, though, as the checkpoint is right after Lucia and Kordell fall down the stairs.

With Tap to Reveal , you need to land the plane. Move up the stairs slowly with the left stick – it’s difficult because the plane door is open. At the top, Lucia finds Raul and they head into the cockpit.

You’re Jason again, who’s with Andrea loading the cash. N.O.O.S.E. appears – you need to protect her while she finishes grabbing the bags. Use the environment as cover, taking out cops however you see fit.

Eventually, Andrea calls out to Jason: she’s done. Rush over to the van and get in. You switch to Lucia again as she and Raul take control of the plane in the cockpit. Hold R2 / RT while pulling the nose up by holding down on the left thumbstick. Lucia automatically lands the plane in the river.

Her and Raul jump into the water and are rescued by friendly boaters. They dock, and Raul hears from Jason: they successfully got away with the cash and he’s going to meet her back at their hotel room. They discuss what will happen to the hard drive without Karim’s help, before Raul tells her to kill time – he’ll be in touch.

Fast forward two weeks. Lucia and Jason are chilling by the pool at the Y Hotel. They chat about the future, then the mission ends. Valentina sends over $250,000 from the airport job , with more to come once it’s been laundered.

Jason asks if Lucia wants to kill time while they wait for Raul to call. Yasmani has an opportunity to hit a bank vault if she wants to do that, or something else, depending on what optional missions you’ve completed. You don’t need to do either; you can do whatever you want to kill time. If you’d rather do your own thing, press Circle / B .

Don’t forget your Family Savings goals in BuckMe! There are plenty of ways to make some quick cash, including:

If you were nice to Nate and received a text message about a present, check your wardrobe as Lucia. You'll find a new Slogan T-Shirt waiting for you!

Eventually, Valentina calls. She knows about the hard drive, and offers to get Jason and Lucia a good deal, provided they’re willing to wait. If they do want to act sooner, they need to call her back, otherwise, wait for further instructions.

To find out more on what happens if you call Valentina or wait, head to our dedicated guide . If you call Valentina back early, Tap to Reveal Eventually, Jason and Lucia receive a note at the Y Hotel front desk, telling them to head to Raul’s boat at the marina. This starts the next main mission, Sunset .

articles.title: PS1 and Xbox Hallmark Christmas Ornaments Are on Sale for Black Friday
articles.body:
If you’re a gamer of a certain age, you may have fond memories of playing the original PlayStation or Xbox consoles. Now you can get gorgeously rendered tiny versions of both classic systems in the form of Christmas ornaments from Hallmark’s Keepsake line. They even light up and make authentic sounds when you press their power buttons. Both ornaments are on sale for under $20 each at Amazon for Black Friday .

The original PlayStation came out in the US in 1994 and has been getting a decent amount of attention lately. LEGO recently turned it into a near 1:1 scale buildable set that I reviewed . This Hallmark ornament PS1 is even closer to the real thing (though much smaller). It’s highly detailed and just beautifully made. When you press the power button the little green light flashes and it plays the iconic PS1 startup sound . The Amazon listing has a video of it. Check it out.

Xbox Console - Hallmark Keepsake Ornament

The Xbox is just as authentically detailed as the PlayStation. It depicts Microsoft’s black-and-green machine, complete with a Duke controller. Press the power button, and the circle on the front lights up, and it plays the startup sound , followed by the opening music from Halo: Combat Evolved. You can see a video of the process on the Amazon listing .

The PS1 normally sells for $29.99, but it’s on sale for $18.80 for Black Friday. That’s only a few cents higher than the all-time low price, not enough to worry about. The Xbox has an MSRP of $27.99, but it’s on sale for $19.60. That’s a new all-time low price.

Either way you go, you probably won’t regret the purchase, assuming you have fond memories of playing these consoles in their heyday. I have the SNES ornament, and I love to put it on the tree each year (and press the power button to hear the music from Super Mario World). That one’s currently out of print. I expect these to go out of print as well at some point in the coming years. Grab one now while it’s on sale if you want it.

articles.body:
The official Grand Theft Auto VI Chapter 5 walkthrough includes strategies not only for the main missions, but also guidance on what to do between key objectives and explanation on major choices. In GTA 6's Chapter 5 – Top of the World Ma, Jason and Lucia find themselves in more trouble than ever.

Chapter 5 Main Mission List and Walkthroughs

There are 8 main story missions in GTA 6’s final chapter. Though shorter than most that came before, there’s still plenty to do in Chapter 5.

Things to Know About the Chapter 5 Safe House

Giorgio's penthouse may not be the most comforting place to live, but there’s plenty of helpful amenities. Given the back-to-back action, you’ll want to keep buffs up. You’ll find the kitchen on the first floor loaded with smoothies and other drinks, plus fruit and food. Snacks and alcohol are available at the bar by the massive TV. The penthouse is also equipped with a full gym.

If you need healing items, Jason and Lucia's bathroom comes with a free Zombix and adrenaline. You’ll may get a refresh on the health items after you save and quit the game and after certain in-game events.

Only a few rooms in Giorgio's home are off limits to you. Be sure to explore where you can to find new activities and other ways to relax. Certain functions of the safe house are only available after you play through story missions.

articles.title: VC Baby Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Kat and Mattia need Jason and Lucia’s help. It’s up to you whether they provide it. Learn more about your options and their consequences in this
articles.body:
Kat and Mattia need Jason and Lucia’s help. It’s up to you whether they provide it. Learn more about your options and their consequences in this official GTA 6 walkthrough for the Chapter 5 mission VC Baby.

This quest only appears after you’ve heard Mattia and Kat talking on the first floor of the penthouse. They’re loud and sit on the couch across from the massive TV. Be aware that whoever you’re playing is locked for this mission as soon as you approach the traitor couple . The character you play changes the scene slightly (Lucia has a lot to say to Kat and Mattia if you’re playing as her), but either character has the same options. As the group talks, Kat goes into labor. Follow Kat, Mattia, and your partner around the corner to the elevators. Just as Kat goes in, Mattia is blocked by Giorgio's security. They won't let him accompany Kat to the hospital. As Kat and the gaurds leave, Mattia turns to Jason and Lucia for help.

Mattia desperately wants to make it to the hospital. It's up to you on whether or not you help him accomplish that goal.

If you help Mattia ( Cross / A ): The mission plays out fully and you’ll receive points toward a more professional Criminal Profile. Continue with the walkthrough for details!

If you refuse Mattia ( Square / X ): The mission ends early. Mattia throws himself off a balcony to break his leg, securing a ride to the hospital without you.

If you choose to help Mattia, the first order of business is to steal the key fob from Dardan. You can't leave the penthouse without it. The partner you’re not playing as distracts Dardan, giving you the opportunity to steal the key fob. It’s on the end of the couch. Return to Mattia and take the elevator down to the sky garage. Now for the exciting part: pick from any of Giorgio’s vehicles . Keep in mind that some of the more luxurious cars can go incredibly fast, but can also be more fragile. Consider how your preferred driving style before choosing. There's no wrong answer here!

Once you’re in a vehicle you need to drive Mattia about 2 mi away to a hospital on the northeast side of Vice City. Your goal is to get him there before Kat gives birth . A timer begins as soon as Mattia and Kat end their call. You can take any route you prefer, but the highway is fastest. Not only can you generally drive faster on the highway, but a pair of reckless racers in sports cars unintentionally clear the way through traffic part of the way through the journey. Just don’t get so focused on them that you miss your exit! So long as you make it to the front of the hospital before the timer runs out , you’ll make it in time. Follow Mattia through the hospital to Kat’s room. If you didn’t make it in time, you’ll still follow him through and watch as the scene plays out. At the end of the scene you’ll be swept away at the hospital entrance by Dardan and his fellow security members who take you back to the penthouse. VC Baby

From here, you can continue with any missions available to you or spend some time working out. There’s also a pool table in the penthouse you can use should you want a break from the action.

articles.title: Doggie Bag Walkthrough - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Vinny needs Lucia to kidnap a famous drug dog to help them with Giorgio's operation. Get everything you need to know about the GTA 6 Chapter 5 mission,
articles.body:
Vinny needs Lucia to kidnap a famous drug dog to help them with Giorgio's operation. Get everything you need to know about the GTA 6 Chapter 5 mission, Doggie Bag, with this official walkthrough .

Once you start this mission, you’ll be thrown right into another so be sure you’re ready before you start! You can get food and drinks in the penthouse kitchen to buff Lucia and Jason’s stats . Approach Vinny on the balcony of the first floor to start this mission. He tells the two they need to collect one more member for the team. You need to kidnap a star drug dog, Rocco. You can approach this mission any way you’d like, but I’d h ighly recommend taking Vinny’s suggestion and using stealth to get to the dog . Members of the Coast Guard are everywhere , and many have assault rifles, making this a particularly lethal group to go up against. If you had all your gear, maybe that wouldn't be so bad, but given that you're operating with only provided equipment the lethal option may be especially challenging.

You’ll also need to hurt Rocco to subdue him if you alert anyone on the way to the dog . If you get caught and would rather not hurt the pup, you can restart the mission or the checkpoint to get another chance at stealth.

There are a few ways onto the ship. You can go through the warehouse Vinny points out, which is easiest and fastest , or you can walk around the terminal and find another way. Just watch out for security who may recognize Lucia immediately and sound the alarm . If you’re going through the warehouse, pass through the first room toward the door on the left. There’s one worker in here who should be unaware of your presence so long as you aren’t running or walk directly in front of him. There’s a first aid cabinet on the wall in this first room containing a Zombix and adrenaline worth grabbing. You can investigate the warehouse more if you’d like, but the best stuff is just ahead in the room labeled "Storage." Use the snap gun to get in and knock out the lone worker inside. Around the large storage room you can pick up cash (which isn’t really all that useful at the moment) along with the following collectibles and aid items:

There's a collectible luxury watch on the shelf

There's Zombix in the first aid bag on the table and a trauma kit with adrenaline on a shelf across from the watch

You can find an assault rifle in this storage room. It’s on the east side of the room on a shelf near door. Open the black rifle case to collect it.

Leave the warehouse through any of the garages in the back of the storage room. Be careful, though. A few guards are gathered not far outside the back of the warehouse. If you wait a few moments two of them drive away, leaving one man to guard an entrance to the ship. Again, you can enter the ships other ways (see that ladder in the image below?), but the ramp up and into the ship is the most straightforward . Be sure to knock out anyone you come across when boarding.

Don't forget to use Focus as you move through the ship to see enemy positions. Again, the Coast Guard is all over this ship, so it's better to play it safe and check who may be ahead, even if you're in combat.

No matter your approach or how you get on the ship, you’ll need to take an elevator to the top deck to find Rocco . There are elevators on the west and east sides of the ship, so you can take whichever is closer to your point of entry. It’s slightly simpler to get to Rocco from the west side of the ship (you’ll likely board on the west side of the ship if you came from the warehouse). You can also run around the balcony of the ship to get to another elevator if you’d like. Just watch out for sentries. Exit on either side of the elevator room, being careful of the Coast Guard. If you’ve already begun combat at this point, be sure to stay in cover as you take out enemies. There’s a ton up here.

The best way to dodge patrols is by taking any staircase down to the lower level to the top deck . Stay to the sides where there’s more cover. It also makes it less likely that guards on the upper deck won’t see you. If you’re still opting for stealth, you can use the provided service pistol to knock out enemies from a distance. It has a silencer and loaded with non-lethal rounds. Even still, landing a headshot puts down targets instantly. Just make sure no one sees you do it! If someone spots a body on the ground they'll alert others, so choose your targets wisely.

Rocco is with his handler at the center of the ship, near a tiki bar . Even if you’re running in shooting you won’t see him until you get closer to this area (if you do, you’ll need to shoot Rocco with a non-lethal round to knock out the dog).

If you’re still moving through with stealth, Rocco wanders off by himself shortly after you see him at the tiki bar. His handler goes to take a break, giving you the chance to swoop in and drug the dog. Approach Rocco and while still hidden, use L2 / LT to focus on Rocco. Praise the dog to call him over, then you’ll get options to pet him ( Triangle / Y ) and drug him ( Cross / A ). Who wouldn’t want to pet this good boy?! You can get a Focus buff and points toward a professional Criminal Profile for petting Rocco.

Once Rocco is knocked out, the whole ship begins buzzing with activity (if it isn’t already) as your escape helicopter approaches. Pick up the drug dog and high tail it to the back of the cruise ship. You can shoot while carrying Rocco and use adrenaline as needed.

Approach the helicopter to successfully end the mission with a cutscene of the crew returning to the penthouse. Next up is Operation Savage Glory .

This walkthrough features some first-person elements. Those come from IGN's GTA 6 Lead Editor, Miranda Sanchez. You can learn more about Miranda and her experience on the About the GTA 6 Guide Editors page.

Up Next: Operation Savage Glory Walkthrough

articles.title: Best Ways to Make Money - GTA 6 Guide - IGN
articles.summary: Early on in Grand Theft Auto VI, you can explore Leonida to your heart’s content. The ways you can meaningfully make and save money, though, change
articles.body:
Early on in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can explore Leonida to your heart’s content. The ways you can meaningfully make and save money, though, change depending on the chapter you’re on. Still, there are specific ways to maximize how much you can make with the tools you have at your disposal. Learn how with this official IGN GTA 6 money making guide.

Use the below links to jump to specific sections of this guide page.

First, though, some quick things to know about how money works:

You can only have $20,000 in cash on hand.

If you get arrested or Wasted, you’ll lose money from your cash or BuckMe account.

The BuckMe account is shared between Jason and Lucia.

Your BuckMe limits change as you progress in the story.

This guide is organized by chapter and include mild spoilers for events and unlocks per chapter. Warning images are in place to ensure you don’t accidentally scroll too far, though please still proceed with caution.

You’re limited in the ways you can make and save money early on. Even once you have BuckMe, you can only have a limited amount in your account. You can’t invest much in your gear or truck because of that (some things cost more than your BuckMe app allows you to save), so we’d recommend prioritizing the Family Savings.

Still, if you see some clothes you want or weapon upgrades, here are ways to make some money early:

Illegal Operations are criminal activities, often led by gangs, that you can infiltrate to earn a lot of money, whether it’s picking up cold, hard cash or finding drugs to sell to a fence. In Chapter 1 specifically, they also have rare and unique weapon variants that you cannot get anywhere else.

While you can take on many Illegal Operations at almost any time, there are three easily accessible ones in Chapter 1. Click on their names below to navigate to individual walkthroughs for them, which guide you through every Key Valuable location, including safe codes.

When looting, Focus Mode is your best friend. Press L3 and R3 when out of combat to highlight nearby valuables for up to 30 seconds (it has a two-second cooldown before you can Focus again). The colors listed below correspond to valuables you can find across Leonida, not just in Illegal Operations:

Fences are contacts that buy illegal contraband from you, including drugs, for varying prices. There are two fences you can sell to in Chapter 1; here’s where to find them and how much they pay for goods:

Both Brian and Donnie require you to stash the goods inside a box rather than selling to them directly. Because of this, you aren’t paid immediately. There’s a small waiting period but you will eventually be paid via the mailbox outside Jason’s apartment (then directly into an account after the Buck Me main mission ).

Until you get an account, cash can be deposited in Jason’s stash under the floorboards in his bedroom. It is a good idea to deposit most of your money until you need it, otherwise you may lose it. Even if you’re arrested or killed, money deposited in Jason and Lucia's BuckMe Family Savings account or stash is not touched.

Shop around when looking to sell, as some contacts offer more money for certain goods than others. For example, it’s better to sell drugs to Donnie in Chapter 1 as he offers more money. You can see how much a fence will buy your goods for by hovering over their map icons when you’ve actively got a bag of product on you.

After completing the Island Dreams main mission , Kenton Rees texts Jason: he’s got three more Dive Site jobs for him, which are marked on your map with purple chest icons. Completing them earns you a decent payout if you need cash.

You don’t need to complete these in Chapter 1 – they can be done any time. But if you’re struggling for cash, it’s a solid option.

Head out via boat to a Dive Site, then put on scuba gear to begin (if you need a boat, Jason has his own just behind his Key Lento house).

Dive down into the water and hold L1 / LB to open the Loadout menu; equip the Metal Detector.

Hold L2 / LT or R2 / RT to scan the seafloor and follow the green light to the treasure. When you’ve found it, a yellow chest icon appears.

Interact with the spot to dig up a treasure.

Treasure can be sold to Kenton. Between the three Dive Sites, you should end up with around $2,600 – a decent boon for Chapter 1.

Pawn shops also buy Doubloons, though for less than Kenton buys them for, only for $200 each.

After you've completed the Buck Me main mission and have access to the BuckMe app on your phone, Cal tips you off that there are lost drug packages hidden around the Keys, with four locations marked on your map, all tied to the Find the Lost Drugs optional mission. Each of these hold around $900 worth of cocaine, and the resistance at each site is minimal, so you shouldn’t have too much trouble tracking them down.

You can carry two duffel bags at a time in Chapter 1, and all four locations' worth of product will fit inside both, so there's no need to make more than one trip if you don’t want to.

Make sure to grab an off-road-capable vehicle before you set out, since all four locations are off the beaten path, and a regular car risks getting stuck in deep water or mud.

Like with Illegal Operations, use Focus Mode to help find the cocaine packages more easily. They will flash purple.

When you’re ready to get paid, head over to Donnie to sell the drugs. You can sell to Brian, but Donnie pays more for narcotics – and why wouldn’t you want more cash?

When driving near Hamlet, you may notice smoke rising from a nearby field to the south. This is a crashed plane. If you’ve got a good eye, you can spot the plane losing control before it crashes when crossing over the bridge leading from Key Lento to Hamlet.

You’ll find some drugs scattered around the wreckage that you can sell to Donnie or Brian.

Don’t forget to use Focus Mode to spot them if you’re having trouble.

A truck with armed men will drive up looking for a fight shortly after you arrive – they want the loot for themselves. Take care of them, then either drive your own car to a fence or steal the truck that the men pulled up in, which doubles as a decent vehicle when searching for the Find the Lost Drugs packages due to its off-road capabilities.

Stick-Ups are stores that you can rob at gunpoint, often rewarding a modest sum of cash. You don’t get properly introduced to Stick-Ups until Chapter 2, but you can do them earlier! The amount you can earn from a Stick-Up varies, but it’s almost always at least a few hundred bucks.

You can rob the following shops in Key Lento and Hamlet:

Make sure you put on a disguise first, whether it’s sunglasses, a mask, a cap, or all three – this will help you escape the cops after you’re reported for the crime, which is inevitable.

It’s also a good idea to keep a change of clothes in your vehicle. You can do this by visiting the Wardrobe in the safehouse and pressing Square / X to Add to Trunk when highlighting an outfit. You can store up to five outfits. When trying to lose your Wanted Level, changing clothes can really help. To do this, go to your vehicle’s trunk and hold L1 / LB to open the Loadout menu.

Press R1 / RB to tab over to Items, then highlight the clothes hanger on the wheel. Press L2 / LT or R2 / RT to cycle through your saved outfits.

When you’ve decided which outfit you want, press Cross / A and your character will change.

To pull off a Stick-Up, visit the store you want to rob and pull out a gun. Aim it at the clerk – you can press Square / X to Threaten them too, if you’d like.

They’ll either open or empty the register for you or tell you to open it yourself; do so with Square / X . Grab the cash.

You can also rob any customers that are inside the establishment, too. Aim at them with your weapon and press Triangle / Y to Rob them. Most will give you some cash, though often not much.

Sometimes, a brave citizen may refuse to hand their cash over to you and try wrestling your gun from you instead. If this happens, mash Square / X to throw them off. They can also grab you if you get too close to them.

Some stores have back rooms you can rob, too. If you’re lucky, there will be a small safe or breakable lockbox with more cash inside. Be quick, though, as it’s likely that someone may have alerted law enforcement by the time you’ve broken into the back.

The police will always be called at a Stick-Up, so prepare for police presence. If you’re stealthy enough and smart with disguises, you can escape sight unseen.

You can see what information the cops have on you by looking at the icons underneath your Wanted Level stars. For a full breakdown on what these icons mean and how to remove them, head to our Wanted Level guide .

This is going to be a common theme in GTA 6: you’ll make more money as you unlock more mechanics. It’s recommended you play through several starting missions in Chapter 2 until you’ve met Moses . You’ll begin this after Vicki recommends you take a vehicle to her mechanic friend. This opens selling stolen cars, and it’s a great way to make money in this chapter.

Once you can fence stolen cars, though, make sure you remember the following:

Use WAiNK to scan targets and get an estimated value. Only steal cars that Moses can accept. You’ll want to go for any car that’ll bring in a few thousand. Don’t waste your time with cars that have minimal return on your time investment.

Moses pays the full estimate from the WAiNK app for cars in top condition. The more you damage a car, the less he’ll pay.

In addition to fencing cars, exploring Leonida is a great way to make money. After Jason is better, hitting Illegal Operations (carefully) can be lucrative. Click on the links below to navigate to individual walkthroughs for each one, all of which teach you exactly how to find every Key Valuable and any optional items for the maximum payout possible.

If you hit all those Illegal Operations for the maximum take values, that’s a lot of cash up for grabs. Definitely way more than enough to pay Linda’s motel rent off, and then some.

There are more Stick-Ups options in Port Gellhorn if you need some quick cash, but once you've completed the Coffee Break mission in Chapter 2 , you'll be able to rob stores with more valuable rewards, like pawn shops and low-end jewelry stores.

Look out for the new green store icons on the map.

Just remember that these will always result in law enforcement being called, so you only have a small time window to loot before you’ve got cops on your tail.

After unlocking Dunk as a fence, he offers some information on drug locations, which appear on your map as purple pill icons. These work similarly to Illegal Operations in that you’re searching an area for valuables – in this case, drugs – and thugs won’t let you get in and out easily, but on a much smaller scale.

Once you’ve stolen the drugs, take them over to Dunk to sell. He buys narcotics for a low price, but it’s good enough for Chapter 2. When you reach Chapter 3 and beyond, some better options for selling stolen goods open up to you.

More money-making details for future chapters in the game are coming soon, come back later for updates!

In the meantime, IGN's official Walkthrough or Illegal Operations guide pages are here to offer you help with any main mission in the game.
